name: @prmaat/verify
description: Reference verifier CLI for PrMaat Verification Spec v0.1. Verifies a signed-event bundle (signature + Merkle inclusion proof + custody check) and exits 0 on conformance, non-zero on failure with a specific failure code from spec §10. Zero runtime dependencies — uses Node 18+ built-in crypto only. Spec at https://prmaat.com/spec/v0.1.
